Name: Emet-Selch - Custom NPC
Author: visorlights
Description:
[center][color=#fce5cd][size=3][b][color=#fce5cd][size=3][b][color=#fce5cd][size=3][b][img]https://i.imgur.com/IiTPRvZ.gif[/img][/b][/size][/color][color=#fce5cd][size=3][b][img]https://i.imgur.com/IiTPRvZ.gif[/img][/b][/size][/color][color=#fce5cd][size=3][b][img]https://i.imgur.com/IiTPRvZ.gif[/img][/b][/size][/color][/b][/size][/color]A 1.6-compatible version is out![color=#fce5cd][size=3][b][img]https://i.imgur.com/IiTPRvZ.gif[/img][/b][/size][/color][color=#fce5cd][size=3][b][img]https://i.imgur.com/IiTPRvZ.gif[/img][/b][/size][/color][color=#fce5cd][size=3][b][img]https://i.imgur.com/IiTPRvZ.gif[/img][/b][/size][/color]
[/b][/size][/color]

As the description says, this mod adds Emet-Selch from FFXIV as a new NPC!

﻿﻿﻿First off, I want to both acknowledge and heartily recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9084?tab=description]Pumpkinium's Stardew Emet-Selch mod[/url]﻿! It’s an excellent mod with delightful writing, tons of content, a lot of polish, and was much of the inspiration for this mod. This mod aims to do something different; if you'd like an Emet-Selch that's a little bit sadder and meaner, here you go! Or, just have both–this mod adds him as a new NPC rather than a Wizard edit expressly for that purpose–though that does mean you’ll have two versions of him walking around with very different AU lore. Perfect for resolving fights in multiplayer, or if you just can’t get enough of this weird old dude. [u]
[/u]﻿[size=3] [/size]

[b]Note:[/b] you can only marry him after you see all his pre-marriage events! If you’re unsure/are having trouble triggering events, there’s a cheat sheet for event conditions at the bottom of the page.[/center]

[center][b][u][size=4][img]https://i.imgur.com/IiTPRvZ.gif[/img][/size][/u][size=4] [/size][u][size=4]Features[/size][/u][size=4] [/size][u][size=4][img]https://i.imgur.com/IiTPRvZ.gif[/img][/size][/u][/b][/center]
[list]
[*]Adds Emet-Selch as a new romanceable NPC, complete with his own schedule, spouse room, patio, and a lot of dialogue. Talk to him and learn about his history, weather his complaining, and get him to tolerate your presence(and maybe more)! This is an AU, with characterization drawn from both Shadowbringers and Endwalker.
[*]11 heart events, with his own little overarching plotline :)
[*]Three appearance options for Emet-Selch: Solus, Hades, and Transformed.
[*]New area, unlockable by a little puzzle quest! Quest is designed to be complete-able early in a save file.
[*]Optional generic dialogue replacement, for more in-character relationship and spouse dialogue. [color=#cccccc](Enabled by default.)[/color]
[/list]
[center][b][u][size=4]
Config[/size][/u][/b][/center]
[list]
[*][b]Emet Appearance[/b]: Character and portrait appearance for Emet-Selch. Options are Solus, Hades, and Transformed. Transformed comes with a handful of new/altered dialogue lines! [default: Solus]
[*][b]Replace Relationship Dialogue[/b]: Overrides generic bouquet, proposal, and married dialogue (for all characters). Ignored if [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20938]Custom Fixed Dialogue[/url]﻿ is installed. [default: true]
[*][b]World Map Edit: [/b]Toggles patching of the world map to add the new area. Currently supports Vanilla, NPCMapLocations, and SVE map appearances. [default: true]
[*][b]Platonic Relationship:[/b] Edits his story events to be platonic, and marks him non-romanceable. Makes all pre-marriage events accessible without dating. [default: false]
[/list]
[b][u][size=4] ﻿[center]﻿[/center][center]Optional Functionality / Integration[/center] [/size][/u][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20938]Custom Fixed Dialogue[/url]﻿ ﻿- if installed, all generic dialogue replacement is done via this, and dialogue is not overwritten for other dateable characters.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8284]Miss Coriel's Unique Courtship Responses[/url]﻿ - Contains extra lines for use by this mod, if installed.
[/list]
[center][size=4][u][b]Future Plans
[/b][/u][/size]

- Post-marriage events [color=#fce5cd][In progress!][/color]
- Azemet/Hythades-inspired version that contains no references to Azem or Hyth in his backstory--meet and romance a younger Hades, fresh from
the Akadaemia.
- Feel free to suggest more!

I'm particularly interested in adding compatibility for a mod to make children more like, well, characters, but I haven't picked anything yet; I'm curious what is favored by the mod community.

I assume I'll be addressing bug fixes in the immediate future, though.[b] Do let me know if you encounter any typos, bugs, or odd behavior! [/b]Feedback and suggestions are also welcome--I'm especially interested in what I can improve in writing.

If I'm not active here, you can also poke me on my [url=https://keytarsolo.tumblr.com/]tumblr[/url].
(And if you'd like to talk more about the mod, you can ask for my discord!)
﻿﻿﻿ [/center][line]
[center]﻿[u][b][size=4]Installation[/size][/b][/u][/center]
Your standard Content Patcher mod, unzip and place '[CP] Emet-Selch - Custom NPC' folder in Stardew Valley/Mods.

[line]

[b][u][size=4][center]Compatibility[size=3][/size][/center][/size][/u][/b]
[center][u][color=#93c47d][b][size=3]+ Compatible With[/size] + [/b][/color][/u][color=#ff0000][color=#ffffff][color=#ff0000][color=#ffffff]
(as far as I am aware; please report any additional errors!)[/color][/color][/color][/color][/center][color=#ff0000][color=#ffffff]
[/color][/color][list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9084?tab=description]Pumpkinium's Emet-Selch Mod[/url][color=#b6b6b6]: [/color]Note: by default, both replace generic relationship/marriage dialogue. Only enable one to do so at a time, depending on which you date, or install Custom Fixed Dialogue.
[*][color=#ff0000][color=#ffffff][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿[/b]: Event cutscenes occasionally clip through additional bushes, but should play as normal. Newest version should fix the Backwoods patching.[/color][/color]
[*][color=#ff0000][color=#ffffff][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]﻿[/color][/color]
[*][color=#ff0000][color=#ffffff][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13497]Stardew Valley Reimagined 3[/url]﻿: [/color][/color]Should now work without issue! Automatically applies a tweaked map edit if this is installed.
[*][b]Any recolor/foliage mods[/b]:  new area should use any updated outdoor tilesheets.
[/list]
[center][b][color=#e06666][size=3][u]- Not Compatible with -[/u][/size][/color][color=#cc0000][size=3][u]
[/u][/size][/color][/b][/center][list]
[*]Potentially incompatible with mods not listed above that edit the Backwoods or Bus Stop maps. I'm generally willing to test for immediately apparent issues if asked, however.
[/list]
[line]
[b][u][size=4][center]Known Issues[/center][/size][/u][/b]
- Installing on a pre-existing file results in the path to the new area being partially blocked by a bush, due to how map generation works. It's still passable, just not by horse.
- Possibly missing a few new dialogue keys in 1.6.
[b]
[/b][center][b][color=#f4cccc]IF YOU HAVE AN ITEM DELIVERY QUEST FROM HIM YOU CANNOT TURN IN from versions 1.2.0 - 1.2.2,[/color][/b] you may need to remove it via the Console Commands mod that comes bundled with SMAPI. [/center]
- If the Frozen Geode quest is bugged, enter '[color=#f4cccc]debug removequest Visorlights.Emet_Geode_Quest[/color]' into the SMAPI console, without quotes.
- If it's the Fire Quartz quest, enter '[color=#f4cccc]debug removequest [/color][color=#f4cccc]Visorlights.Emet_FireQuartz_Quest[/color]' instead.

As always, let me know if there are any errors!
